observations: body L1-L43: the Addenda to the second volume, continued. The page numbers of the second volume stand bold at the head of the entries, a line number after a comma in roman («32,3»); the numbers corrected and their corrections are italic.

body L1: the minutes of «348° 44″», «190° 56″» and «349° 4″» are printed with double primes, those of «191° 16′» with a single prime; they are transcribed as printed. Both pairs make 540° (191° 16′ + 348° 44′, 190° 56′ + 349° 4′).

body L3-L11: the entry on p. 35, n. ad nr. 77. «Marw ar-rūdh» (L3), «Qaṣr Ibn Aḥnaf» and the title of Le Strange's paper are italic; «Rawlinson», «Schefer», «Žukovsky», «de Goeje», «Tomaschek», «Yate», «Barthold», «al-» «Muqaddasī» and «Le Strange» are letter-spaced, their initials not.
body L4: «مروچق» and «مروچاق», the Persian forms with the three dots of چ (č), are set right to left inside the Latin line; the closing parenthesis follows the second, as printed.
body L7: the dash measures 10.2 pt.
body L8: with the Arabic mile of 1973 m that the first volume uses, 5 parasangs of three miles are 29.6 km, as printed.
body L10: «Ḥamd–Allah» has a long dash (5.2 pt); a stop, not a comma, follows «Society».

body L12-L19: the entry on p. 35, n. ad nr. 80. «Binkat», «Tāshkend», «India», «Ūlūgh-čat», «Khotan», «Ilči» and the title of Marquart's book are italic; «al-Bīrūnī», «Tomaschek» and «Marquart» are letter-spaced, their initials not. The θ of «θινος» (L13) and «Λίθινος» (L15) is the curly form of this type (ϑ).
body L16: the first y of «Qyzyl-ṣū» prints broken; a dot under it and one over the hyphen are specks.

body L17, L30: the s of «Ērānśahr» carries an acute, not the háček of č and ž on this page; the mark after the c of «Xorenacʿi» (L17) is a half ring. The a of «Geographie» (L17) prints broken, like a u.
body L19: «ختن» is set inside the parentheses, right to left. Khotan lies at 37.1° N, 79.9° E.

body L26-L30: the entry on p. 44, n. ad nr. 189. A comma follows «44»; a speck joined to the top of the second 4 makes it look like a semicolon. «ad-Daybul», the title of Tomaschek's paper and «Ērānśahr» are italic; «Tomaschek» and «Marquart» are letter-spaced. The hyphen of «Lārī-bandar» (L28) is printed as a round dot (1.9 by 1.7 pt) at the height of a hyphen; «phil.–hist.» (L29) has a long dash (5.4 pt). Raised dots after «Sitzsber.» and between «d.» and «k.» (L29) are specks.

body L31-L35: the entry on p. 45, n. ad nr. 199. «Qiṭisfān», «Aqṭēsifōn», «Qṭīsfūn», «et» at the end of L32, the title of Gismondi's edition and «Ṭaysafūn» are italic; «Maris», «Amri», «Slibae» and «ad-Dimashqī» are letter-spaced. «قطيسفون» and «اقطسفون» are set right to left inside the Latin lines. The dot under the S of «Ṣalībā» (L34) touches the letter; the second a of «Ṭaysafūn» prints broken; a dot between «de» and «Patriarchis» (L33) is a speck. The dash at the head of L35 measures 9.8 pt, and «quoque..» has two stops, as printed.

body L36-L38: the entry on p. 47, n. ad nr. 213. «Asdūd» and «Annales» are italic; «Ḥamzah al-Iṣfahānī» is letter-spaced, and the dot under its s touches the letter. The stop after «dicit)» prints small (0.7 pt).

body L41-L42: «Σήρα» has the acute, and its η prints with the short upright stroke after it; a dot after «nr.» (L41) is a speck. The Later Han dynasty, whose capital was Lo-yang, reigned from 25 to 220, as printed. «Marquart» is letter-spaced.
body L43: the o of «pro» prints broken.
notes L1-L2: one note across the measure, under a short rule (114.7 pt). «Merverrud» is italic; the Russian title is transliterated with č and šč, and the t of «otdjelenija» prints like an l.
source_authority: Controlling master page image. Embedded text is not the authority for a reading.
transcription_convention: Source line breaks, hyphenation, quotation signs and word-level type distinctions retained. L numbers count text-bearing lines.
review_responsibility: Transcribed by Claude from the page images; Greek, Arabic, numbers and signs read on enlarged images. Not reviewed by a person.
